definition: A primary spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel intended to contain the principal area of occupation or use associated with that legal unit.
A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel intended primarily for the parking of a motor vehicle.
A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel intended primarily for the storage of goods or possessions.
A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel forming an elevated external or semi-external area associated with a building.
A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel forming an open or partly enclosed external area at or near ground level.
A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel located at, within, immediately below or above the roof level of a building, or otherwise associated with its roof volume.
altlabel: roof space|roof void|attic space|roofspace|roof area|roof terrace

definition: A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel designated for the exclusive or restricted use of the occupants or owners of that legal unit, without necessarily forming part of its principal unit.
altlabel: private use area|exclusive use area|private area|exclusive-use area

definition: A spatial component of a lot, unit, or parcel whose role is not represented by another term in this vocabulary.
